objective: Establish deterministic vendor-neutral operational SLO, capacity and cost monitoring using the canonical P02 capacity/cost envelope and existing P07 quality-SLO principles, without inventing production SLAs or budget values and without granting scaling, cost-shedding, runtime or trading authority.
scope: Evaluate canonical internal latency objectives from the P02 capacity/cost envelope
Escalate repeated latency misses to architecture review after three explicit consecutive miss windows
Evaluate current workload against canonical OPERATING and STRESS capacity envelopes
Trigger capacity review at 70 percent of the OPERATING envelope and critical review at the STRESS boundary
Evaluate projected monthly cost only against an explicit caller-supplied owner budget
Apply canonical 70/85/100 percent cost guardrails as recommendations only
Detect explicit 2x daily cost anomalies when an expected daily baseline is supplied
Preserve Risk, Firewall, Security, Audit, Reconciliation and Kill Switch workloads from cost-shedding recommendations
Produce deterministic content-addressed monitoring snapshots and evidence
Keep P22-J NOT_STARTED until canonical P22-I closure
out_of_scope: Selecting or provisioning an observability vendor
tests: Canonical latency targets exactly match the P02 architecture envelope
Three consecutive explicit latency miss windows require architecture review
Capacity review begins at 70 percent of OPERATING and critical review begins at the STRESS boundary
Cost evaluation requires a caller-supplied monthly budget and never invents one
70/85/100 percent budget guardrails and 2x daily anomaly detection are deterministic
Safety-critical workloads are never recommended for cost shedding
P22-I evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No automatic scaling or cost shedding
rollback: Revert P22-I policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P22-A..P22-H remain canonical complete and P22-J remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
